deploy-bot: Deploy started: dedicated/private -> cluster `dedicated-usw2-42` :rocket:
deploy-bot: Release tag `release/v2.3.1`, commit `b7f4c9a`. Strategy: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Initiated by @mira. Change window: 30m.
mira: Ack. Notes: includes latency fixes + token-batching adjustment. Will watch app traces.
sanjay: Heads-up — prod read replica lag hit 120ms spikes yesterday; will keep DB metrics open.
deploy-bot: Canary phase 1: 5% rolled to pool `dedicated-usw2-pool-B`. Healthchecks starting.
olivia: Seeing short 503 spikes on `/v1/generate` around 15:32 in the new canary group. Pulling logs now. :eyes:
olivia: ```
2026-03-20T15:32:14Z nginx upstream: 502, "connection reset by peer"
2026-03-20T15:32:18Z model-server: WARN failed request id=4a7f err='upstream reset'
```
chris: If 503s >2m, recommend pin back to `release/v2.3.0` and abort the rollout. Keep me posted.
mira: @olivia any OOMs or KV cache issues? also check sidecar logs for timeouts.
olivia: No OOMs. Sidecar shows intermittent `connection reset by peer` to model process, nginx upstream pool shows occasional 502s. Manually scaling model replicas from 2 -> 4 in the canary pool.
deploy-bot: Canary phase 1 health: degraded (errors >1% over 2m). Automatic rollout paused. Awaiting operator action. :warning:
mira: Pausing rollout. I'll scale and restart ingress on pool-B, then re-run healthchecks. @sanjay can you open DB dashboard? link: https://grafana.redwood/prod/db/reads
sanjay: DB dashboard open — read latency and replica lag are stable. Not DB.
mira: Good. Restarting ingress proxies on pool-B and scaling replicas applied. Re-triggering manual canary retry. :hammer_and_wrench:
deploy-bot: Manual canary retry initiated by mira. Target: `dedicated-usw2-pool-B`. Healthchecks starting.
olivia: Retry looks stable at 60s. Error rate down to 0.12% — no 5xxs in the last 30s. :white_check_mark:
chris: Recommend proceed to 25% but keep rollback ready. I'll create a rollback pin tag `release/v2.3.1-pin-20260320` just in case.
deploy-bot: Rollout to 25% started. Estimated finish ~2m.
deploy-bot: Rollout to 25% complete. All checks passing. Scheduling next step (wait window) for 5m.
mira: Leaving an extra 10m buffer before 100% cutover to watch traces and cost counters. If anything odd, we'll pin and abort.
deploy-bot: Deploy (partial) finished at 1932104537. Current rollout: 25% active. commit `b7f4c9a`. Operator: mira. To resume to 100% run `/deploy resume 1932104444`
